compliance_authority: World Wide Web Consortium (W3C) Accessibility Guidelines Working Group

AA.name: Level AA (Mandatory Legal Minimum)
AA.description: Standard compliance baseline required by global regulatory frameworks including ADA Title III, Section 508, and EN 301 549.

body_text.font_size_definition: Text smaller than 18pt (24px) regular weight or smaller than 14pt (18.66px) bold weight.

large_display_text.font_size_definition: Text at or above 18pt (24px) regular weight or at or above 14pt (18.66px) bold weight (typically font-weight >= 700).

incidental_or_decorative_text.font_size_definition: Text or images of text that are part of an inactive user interface component, pure decoration, or part of a picture that contains significant other visual content.

ui_components_and_graphical_objects.description: Visual information required to identify user interface components and states, or graphical objects necessary for comprehension.

AAA.name: Level AAA (Enhanced Accessibility)
AAA.description: Optimal accessibility threshold providing enhanced visual legibility for high-consequence public and enterprise portals.

body_text.font_size_definition: Text smaller than 18pt (24px) regular or 14pt (18.66px) bold.

large_display_text.font_size_definition: Text at or above 18pt (24px) regular or 14pt (18.66px) bold.

mathematical_formula.relative_luminance: L = 0.2126 * R + 0.7152 * G + 0.0722 * B, where sRGB channels are linearized: if c_sRGB <= 0.04045 then c = c_sRGB / 12.92 else c = ((c_sRGB + 0.055) / 1.055) ^ 2.4
mathematical_formula.contrast_ratio: (L1 + 0.05) / (L2 + 0.05), where L1 is the relative luminance of the lighter color and L2 is the relative luminance of the darker color
